_doc: Manifest for tools/flow-effort-check.mjs (SKILL K31, K32, K34; CR-97; DESIGN G-22). STATE DESCRIBED: the tree AFTER the ChatGPT fix of polish3u (output/reports/polish3u-code.md: the setup choice, the assistant page and the connections card all call ChatGptSignIn.start; WebAccount.webSignIn is false for CHATGPT, so its in-app page is unreachable). Everything else is the tree as output/reports/signin-inventory.md describes it (row numbers in each note); rows 6, 8 and 9 were classified there from grep, not read. The kind of the two bank steps is the manifest author's reading of inventory rows 4 and 11. Method tables exist only where a research report gives the methods; a function with no table is a finding, not a gap to hide. No filters and no exceptions: a finding stays until the flow is fixed or a real reason is recorded.
